text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful change of pace. Thank 
you for inviting me, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I have been rather busy 
lately. In that sense as well, I truly 
appreciate you calling out to me—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have come to collect the handover 
materials regarding the annual event 
schedule revisions.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At the board meeting the other day, you 
were only meant to prepare the draft, and 
I was supposed to take over the rest of 
the work.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, no.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The documents are in the dorm, so I'll go 
fetch them right away. Could you wait here 
in the student council room for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ………………Now then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Those documents, huh... What a pain...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it's quite the opposite. 
It's already been completely wrapped up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Not just a draft, but the finished 
manuscript, okay?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that I forgot about the 
handover, you see? I simply got swept up 
in my work as inspiration struck, or 
rather, to sum it up—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Well, put plainly, that's what it comes 
down to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is quite a predicament. Air 
Groove is always warning me not to hog all 
the work for myself, and yet—"
choice_data_list: Let's try to play it off somehow!
Let me be honest with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
D-Deceive them? As in, trick them? No 
matter what, that's going too far...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, but still... I see. Telling her the 
truth would only cause unnecessary 
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Being pure and upright is not necessarily 
what is right, is it? As always, your 
words are rich in meaning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alright! For now, let's conceal that 
finished draft and—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What are you trying to hide, President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: !? A-Air Groove! When did you—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I came back because you were acting 
strange, and look at you... Honestly!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Today of all days, I will talk with you 
thoooo-roughly until you understand!"

And so, the two of us received a thorough 
scolding from Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Even the 'Emperor' is 
powerless before an angry 'Empress'...

“Still, to have someone who will scold you 
so properly and thoroughly—”
choice_data_list: I'm grateful to have such good friends.
I'm grateful to have such good friends.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? —Haha, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I learned that the hard way, right down to 
my bones! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Is this really the time to be 
laughing?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad, my bad. Please continue to 
scold me whenever needed! ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's all I can do. At the very 
least, I'll go and offer my sincere 
apologies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—And so, you went and handled it all by 
yourself again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even after I specifically advised you that 
we should divide the workload... Good 
grief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I am truly sorry. I have no excuse for 
my actions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Proper delegation of work is also a 
leader's duty. I shall engrave that into 
my heart time and time again."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's part of it too, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Since you appear to be truly remorseful, I 
shall refrain from scolding you further. 
However――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Please remember this, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as you strive to fulfill happiness 
for us all—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We, too, seek nothing less than your 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —And with that, I was made to realize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My perspective is still far too narrow.

Symboli Rudolf murmured those words, 
looking blissful.
